{{Quote|They convince ol' D-Mot that I'm drunk as a Lucrusian fengrill, and they's a' helpin' me get home.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raquid Krev]]|<ref name="Never Had A Chance">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations|story=Never Had A Chance}}</ref>}}
'''Lucrusian fengrills''' were a type of creature. To be as "drunk as a Lucrusian fengrill" was a saying that could refer to an inebriated individual.
